15	// or m (minutes), for example "5d", "3h" or "10m".

17		s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
18		if len(s) < 2 {
19			return 0, ErrFormat

22		if err != nil || n < 0 {
23			return 0, ErrFormat

25		var unit time.Duration
26		switch s[len(s)-1] {
27		case 'd':

29		case 'h':
30			unit = time.Hour
31		case 'm':

33		default:
